title: The Architecture of Money: Mapping Financial Power in the Age of Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine The Architecture of Money: Mapping Financial Power in the Age of Bitcoin Carlijn Kingma, Thomas Bollen, and Martijn Jeroen van der Linden on The Waterworks of Money, the hidden structures of finance, and bitcoin's place in Europe's monetary future. This post The Architecture of Money: Mapping Financial Power in the Age of Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Dennis Koch .
